decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 2 - Details are required of the windows in order to comply fully with this condition
description: Following approval for erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to 3 one bedroom flats and 5 two bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicular/pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces (3 of which are covered) covered cycle stand, refuse storage area, and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to condition 2 (roof / windows over parking / cycle area) of permission dated 25/07/2002
